steps.title: Which line moved
steps.say: The line you moved to the right was the supply curve, not demand. Demand is still unshifted, and supply has shifted by 2.

steps.title: Why the price fell
steps.say: When supply moves right, sellers offer more at every price. Buyers have not changed, so the market only clears at a lower price, which is now 4 instead of 5, and the quantity rises from 5 to 6.

steps.title: Now try demand
steps.say: If you want demand to rise, drag the other curve to the right. Then both price and quantity go up. Try it and compare.
